name: Dorori Ama Ero Gohoushi Seikatsu!
original_name: どろり甘エロご奉仕性活！
source:
It's like a dream that this could be happening to me.

I am all alone, no family to rely on and no money left to my name. I have been wondering around aimlessly trying to decide what to do. "... are you alright?" I find a little girl speaking to me. She listened to my story and said she would like to come to my home and take care of me for a while...
